title: Grateful Dead Live at Fresno Convention Center on 1969-06-13
lineage: Master Soundboard Cassette > Cass > DAT > ZA2 > SF > CD

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a spirited show highlighted by Pigpen’s organ on “Sittin’ on Top of the World”, Jerry’s ripping guitar, and an epic 21‑minute “Lovelight”.
ai_review.review: The recording is generally clear and well‑balanced for a 1969 soundboard tape, though listeners note occasional feedback and sections that sound out of tune. Musically the band builds energy through the night, delivering strong performances of Schoolgirl (with guest vocals), St. Stephen, Eleven, and a marathon Lovelight that many reviewers call a show‑stopper, while early songs suffer from tuning wobble.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the performance and recording quality, but several point out tuning problems and a few low‑star ratings, yielding an overall mid‑range score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally crisp and top‑notch soundboard mix; occasional feedback around 13 min and noticeable out‑of‑tune sections (Morning Dew, The Eleven) due to loose machine heads.

standout_songs: Sittin' on Top of the World
show_quality.setlist_flow: The first half is solid but a bit restrained; energy ramps up in the second set with extended jams, guest contributions and an explosive Lovelight that carries the show to its climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as tearing it up, prowling the stage like a panther, delivering scorching lead guitar especially on Lovelight.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned ripping bass lines valiantly during the extended jams.
band_member_comments.Bob: Pigpen’s organ work praised (especially on “Sittin' on Top of the World”), though his jokes received mixed reactions.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s keyboards are clear on Lovelight; a guest flutist (Charles Lloyd or Gary Larkey) is noted but not part of the core keyboard line‑up.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy and Mickey’s drumming described as dancing and energetic, keeping the groove despite tuning issues.
